title: Entanglement Links
description: Two photons from one source stay one system however far apart they go. A store of such pairs, split between two places, makes one channel. Unlocks the Entangled Link and an early Entanglement Tuner.

puzzle.goal: Two entangled particles are measured at two settings each, and four correlations A, B, C and D are found, one for each pair of settings. Write the sum S whose size tells a quantum channel from any classical one (it can reach 2√2; nothing classical passes 2). The second correlation enters with a minus sign.
puzzle.name: CHSH sum
puzzle.ask: Find S for A = @{A}, B = @{B}, C = @{C} and D = @{D} (detectors at 0°, 45°, 22.5° and 67.5°).
puzzle.method: Each correlation is −cos of the angle between the two detectors; at these four angles three are +0.707 and one −0.707.
